'''R5-P9''' was a black and gray [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech]] [[Droid/Legends|droid]] that served onboard [[Ekelarc Yong/Legends|Ekelarc Yong's]] [[BTL Y-wing starfighter/Legends|Y-wing starfighter]] during the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]].<ref name="Hasbro toy" /> The droid was destroyed, along with Yong and his [[Starfighter/Legends|fighter]] during the battle.<ref name="ROTJ" />
